name: CFX Factor
summary: Flat-rate factoring for owner-operators and fleets, with non-recourse options and a fuel savings program.
differentiator: States its standard term plainly: one year, which it calls the industry norm, with month-to-month available. Most factors bury the term; CFX puts it in its FAQ next to a 2% to 3% flat rate and no monthly minimum.

terms.rate: The rate at CFX is 2% to 3% of the invoice
terms.advance: Up to 98%, advanced the same day
terms.contract: Standard term is one year; month-to-month agreements exist
terms.minimum: Flat rate with no monthly minimum
terms.transfers: Zero transaction fees; wire fees apply
terms.fuel: Save up to 80 cents per gallon at major truck stops (CFX claim)

bestFor: Carriers who want the term stated before they apply.
skipIf: You will not sign a year; ask for month-to-month and its rate.
